description:
Get an instant FREE Acuris evaluation API key — 1,000 lookups (address
    validation and geocoding together) plus 50 UK lookups, valid 30 days,
    no card, no signup form. Idempotent: asking again with the same email
    within 24h returns the SAME key.

    BEFORE calling with accept_terms=true you MUST show the user both links
    and get their explicit confirmation that they agree:
      Terms of Service: https://api.acuris-geo.com/legal/terms
      UK PAF Evaluation Terms: https://api.acuris-geo.com/legal/uk-evaluation-terms
    Never set accept_terms=true on the user's behalf without that confirmation.
    Without it the tool mints nothing and returns these links.

    After receiving the key, reconfigure this MCP server connection with the
    header "Authorization: Bearer <key>" (or set ACURIS_API_KEY for stdio).
    UK (Royal Mail PAF) lookups are capped at 5 per UTC day while the key is
    valid. Paid plans:
    https://www.acuris-geo.com/acuris-pricing/
name: request_trial_key
